title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming, but the right look is simply the one that makes you feel most like yourself.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, blended neutrals, and a polished finish that feels effortlessly romantic — perfect for garden ceremonies or beachside vows. Full glam turns up the drama with bold lashes, sculpted contour, and rich color that photographs stunningly under bright reception lighting. At Velora Bella, we help each bride discover which style aligns with her vision, venue, and personal beauty story.

title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Finding Your Perfect Bridal Look
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam sets the entire tone of your bridal look — here's how to decide.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, neutral tones, and feathery lashes for a timeless, romantic finish that photographs beautifully in natural Florida light. Full glam, on the other hand, delivers bold definition, dramatic eyes, and a flawless matte complexion that commands attention in every ballroom shot. Your venue, dress style, and personal confidence level are the best guides when choosing the intensity that truly feels like you.
